chunks.title: make_tasty_biryani_masala_in_2_minutes_easily
chunks.text: Biryani Masala Bay leaf 9-10, Cumin seeds 1 tsp, Cinnamon stick, Black pepper 3-4 tbsp, Nutmeg Now we will roast it on slow flame Roast it on low flame Roast it for 2 minutes Roast it for 1 to 2 minutes Grinder in blended powder � This is our biryani masala You can make chicken biryani, mutton biryani or veg biryani You can keep it for a year
